description:
∙       Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack applications and services using Java and Python. 
 ∙      Build and maintain front-end interfaces (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside back-end APIs and          services.
 ∙      Design and consume RESTful APIs to connect front-end and back-end components.
 ∙      Support the integration and fine-tuning of AI/LLM-based features into existing and new applications.
 ∙      Build and maintain RPA (Robotic Process Automation) workflows to automate repetitive business processes.
 ∙      Design, query, and maintain relational databases (RDB), ensuring data integrity and performance.
 ∙      Collaborate with designers and product stakeholders to implement clean, user-friendly UI/UX.
 ∙      Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
 ∙      Assist in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps automation.
 ∙      Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot applications on Linux (Ubuntu) and Windows Server environments.
 ∙      Use Git for version control and participate in code reviews and pull requests.
 ∙      Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and cross-functional team meetings.
 ∙      Document technical processes, code changes, and system configurations.
 ∙      Troubleshoot and resolve bugs and production issues in a timely manner.

 ∙      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
 ∙      Working knowledge of Java and Python programming languages.
 ∙      Basic front-end development experience (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern framework such as React, Angular, or Vue is a plus).
 ∙      Understanding of RESTful API design and integration.
 ∙      Foundational understanding of AI/LLM concepts and practical applications.
 ∙      Understanding of relational databases (RDB), including SQL and schema design.
 ∙      Basic knowledge of UI/UX design principles and best practices.
 ∙      Exposure to DevOps tools and practices (e.g., CI/CD, containerization).
 ∙      Experience with or exposure to RPA (Robotic Process Automation) tools (e.g., Brity Works, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate).
 ∙      Experience with Linux/Ubuntu and Windows Server operating environments.
 ∙      Familiarity with Git and collaborative version control workflows.
 ∙      Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodology.
 ∙      Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.
 ∙      Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Performance Expectations 
 ∙      Develop comprehensive, scalable design systems
 ∙      Create interactive wireframes and prototypes
 ∙      Implement accessible, responsive interfaces
 ∙      Conduct rigorous UX research and usability testing
 ∙      Optimize application performance and user engagement
 Preferred Qualifications 
 ∙      English-Korean bilingual communication skills.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
